title.zh: Phantom 通过 Kalshi 集成向美国用户推出预测市场
title.en: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users

current_state.zh: Phantom通过集成Kalshi，为符合条件的美国用户推出受CFTC监管的预测市场，允许在应用内交易加密货币价格、体育及其他事件，资金通过Phantom Cash提供。
current_state.en: Phantom launched CFTC-regulated prediction markets for eligible US users through a Kalshi integration, allowing in-app trading on crypto prices, sports, and other events funded via Phantom Cash.

updates.title_zh: 【Phantom 向美国用户上线 Kalshi 预测市场】
updates.title_en: 【Phantom 向美国用户上线 Kalshi 预测市场】
updates.what_changed_zh: Phantom于10月23日开始向美国用户逐步推出应用内Kalshi预测市场交易，交易资金来自Phantom Cash稳定币余额，每份合约收费0.02美元，并在密歇根州、内华达州和华盛顿州屏蔽某些市场类别，依据是一份涵盖经纪商注册的有条件CFTC不采取行动函。
updates.what_changed_en: Phantom began rolling out in-app Kalshi prediction-market trading for US users on October 23, funding trades from Phantom Cash stablecoin balances with $0.02 per-contract fees and blocking certain market categories in Michigan, Nevada and Washington, relying on a conditional CFTC no-action letter covering broker registration.
